# ActOne Cinema - Hire a cinema screen or lounge area for your meeting or activity

# ActOne Cinema - Hire a cinema screen or lounge area for your meeting or activity

Concessions available for schools and local groups in the old library on Acton High Street.

![ActOne_Logo](https://www.egfl.org.uk/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/ActOne_Logo.png?itok=7EsvQ0Ga)

30 August 2024

### Hire a cinema screen

Concessions available for schools and  local groups

We have 2 beautiful, air conditioned, 60-seat screening rooms, with 5m screen, both are available to hire and suitable for all kinds of film events, including, private screenings and presentations.

Your school or group can make use of ActOne Cinema and café on any weekday except Tuesday, with flexible times to suit you, within normal working hours.

We can also provide technical support with PA systems. The cinema is situated in the old library on Acton High Street, and has excellent public transport links, and nearby off-street parking.

We can also provide high quality catering from our café, including baked goods, coffee, and other refreshments as well as popcorn.

Rates: £175 plus VAT per hour (minimum 2 hours hire)

£80 plus VAT fee for technical support

Catering priced by arrangement

### Use our spacious lounge area for your activity or meeting

Concessions available for schools and  local groups

- £50 per hour on weekdays before 6pm
- £60 per hour on weekdays after 6pm
- £75 per hour on weekends before 6pm
- £100 per hour on weekends after 6pm

### Contact

Dimitris Poteas by email at manager@actonecinema.co.uk

Further information: [Hire Us (actonecinema.co.uk)](https://www.actonecinema.co.uk/hire-us)

issues: Range mixes two spaces: the £50 minimum is lounge hire and the £175 maximum is screening-room hire. This is disclosed in price_basis.
vat is null even though the screening rate is stated as plus VAT. The lounge rates have no VAT stated, so a single field cannot capture both.
Screening room has a minimum 2-hour hire (effective £350 + VAT minimum). This is noted in price_basis but not in a structured field.
The source is a 2024 third-party reprint from Ealing Grid for Learning, so the rates may be stale.
judge.fix_hint: When a venue offers several hireable spaces, consider recording the screen-hire price separately from the lounge or other-room prices, or flag it as mixed. Capture minimum-hours terms (e.g. min 2 hrs × rate) in a structured field, and set vat per component or as 'mixed' when only some rates are plus VAT.
